description: Golden corpus for the Reactory speech evaluation harness (SPEECH-007). Representative Reactory sentences: short greetings, long narration, domain vocabulary, numbers, dates, abbreviations and five languages. Every entry is rendered by every configured engine+voice for its language, transcribed by the local STT service and scored for round-trip intelligibility, duration and prosody. `use` is the intended use of the sentence; `max_wer` is the quality target used by `python -m app.eval run --fail-on-wer` (it is a target, not a promise: the multilingual entries currently fail and are the evidence for SPEECH-010).
metrics_note: WER is computed over whitespace tokens for space-delimited languages and over characters for Japanese and Chinese; CER is always over characters. Both are computed after Unicode NFKC normalisation, case folding and punctuation removal.

entries.text: Hi Werner, how can I help?
Good morning. Ready when you are.

The Reactory platform turns a support ticket into a reviewable change. A planning agent breaks the work into steps, a developer agent writes the code, and a reviewer agent checks it against the ticket. Every step is recorded, so the team can see what happened and why.
Reactory, GraphQL, Kubernetes, ONNX and FQDN all appear in the platform vocabulary.
ONNX runtime, faster-whisper and Kokoro-82M run entirely on the CPU, with no GPU and no paid API.
The API returns JSON over HTTPS, and the CLI reads the SDK, e.g. for the FQDN.
Your invoice totals 1,284.50 rand for 12 seats, with a 7.5 percent discount.
The sprint ends on 14 March 2027 at 09:30, and the review is on 2027-03-15.
Ticket SPEECH-007 covers the evaluation harness for Phase 6.
Which engine should route an empathetic apology in French?

Bonjour Werner, comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui ?
La plateforme Reactory transforme un ticket de support en une modification vérifiable, avec une étape de planification, une étape de développement et une étape de revue.
La facture s'élève à 1 284,50 rands pour 12 licences.
こんにちは、ワーナーさん。今日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
リアクトリーは、サポートチケットを確認可能な変更に変換するプラットフォームです。計画、実装、レビューの各段階が記録されます。
GraphQL と Kubernetes と ONNX を、CPU だけで実行できます。
你好，维尔纳。今天我能帮你做什么？
Reactory 平台把支持工单转换成可以审查的代码变更，每一个步骤都会被记录下来。
GraphQL、Kubernetes 和 ONNX 都可以在 CPU 上运行。
Hola Werner, ¿en qué puedo ayudarte hoy?
La plataforma Reactory convierte un ticket de soporte en un cambio revisable, paso a paso, con cada decisión registrada.
